document: Prioritise front line police officers and police staff for covid 19 vaccination, Police officers and staff have daily contact with the public, enter homes and give life saving first aid. They are at high risk for catching and spreading covid 19. Please give consideration for this group to be a priority in the covid 19 vaccination programme., Keep police officers and staff safe in the course of their duties to protect the public.

Honour 2nd dose of Pfizer vaccine within 21 - 28 days for recipients of 1st dose, Change decision to extend the length of time between Pfizer vaccine doses. It should be 21 to 28 days which is in line with vaccine manufacturers evidence based recommendation., The change in dosage schedule after consent to first dose is unethical. These patients signed up to a dosage schedule that was licensed and tested, this new schedule is unknown territory. 

The safety and efficacy of the vaccine has not been evaluated on different dosing schedules. Changing the dosing schedule undermines confidence and risks leaving people vulnerable to COVID-19.  

Those that have received the 1st dose are high risk groups and front line workers requiring protection

Government need to deliver second dose of Pfizer Covid vaccine at 21 days., Delivery of the Pfizer vaccine has been approved for use in the UK. With very limited research available regarding safety we have placed our trust in the Government by consenting to have this vaccine to essentially preserve life and save our NHS. We strongly oppose the delay in second dose delivery., The Government needs to give the Pfizer vaccine in line with Pfizer's recommendations.  They should not delay the 2nd dose of the vaccine.
The Pfizer vaccination has been agreed for usage in the the UK for which we are grateful.
Pfizer's evidence base & efficacy rates for the vaccine are based on delivery of the 2nd vaccine dose after 21 days. Its seems unscientific and unethical for our Chief Medical Officers to defend a delay when they have no robust evidence to inform this decision.

Prioritise vaccination of frontline workers potentially exposed to Covid-19., Ensure that maximum protection to the greatest number of people is achieved by priority vaccination of frontline workers potentially exposed to high viral load,  including but not limited to, NHS staff, teachers and school support workers, care home staff, social workers and police., Common sense dictates that vaccination of those potentially exposed to the highest viral load will reduce the chance of super spreaders and will protect the most vulnerable. Our children's education has already suffered a year of disruption; elderly are at risk as care home staff come into work; frontline workers are expected to keep our country functioning with no protection offered. We are now approaching a stage when vaccination of key workers is not only possible but our responsibility.

Prioritise one parent of  young adults in care homes for Covid-19 vaccination., This petition calls for parents..
To have the same rights i.e. getting tested regularly and getting vaccinated at the same time as the residents and the carers so we can see and touch our children., Parents haven't touched or cuddled their children in ten months. Parents have only seen their children outside from two metres away.Some residents haven't  seen their families at all in this time as it causes them too much stress under these restrictions.
 Most vulnerable young adults don't understand Covid -19.They are confused upset and sad and don't understand why their families don't touch / cuddle them anymore. 
Parents are worried sick as cases rise that something will happen to their children due to Covid-19 or because of their existing condition and they havn't held them since March 2019.Touch is so important to vulnerable young adults especially from their families.

Increase funding for the NHS Gender Clinic to make it more widely accessible, I would like to see an increase in funding for the NHS's gender clinics, and make gender clinics more widely available across the country., The NHS gender clinic is currently incredibly underfunded and has waiting lists of years just for an appointment. Non-cisgender people are missing out on treatment and threapy that could be life saving - the suicide rate for transgender people is still incredibly high, largely due to the difficulty of accesing care.

Make prison staff top priority as key workers to recieve the covid 19 vaccine, Prison staff are not even on the list to recieve the vaccine let alone top priority! How will the virus stop coming into the hmps unless staff are vaccinated? Prisoners are now rountinely tested for covid upon entering a hmp but as far as staff go its not mandatory to betested. The vaccine is needed, I want prison staff to made a top priority in having the covid vaccine to help stop the transmission of covid in the prisons

VACCINATION FOR SCHOOL STAFF, Recognise that school staff are at risk just as much as frontline/care staff.
Vaccinate ALL SCHOOL STAFF WORKING IN SCHOOLS WITH THE CHILDREN OF FRONTLINE STAFF DESERVE TO BE TREATED AS FRONTLINE STAFF AND BE VACCINATED AGAINST COVID19, Protecting ALL STAFF IN SCHOOLS WHO ARE STILL TEACHING VULNERABLE/ FRONTLINE WORKERS PUPILS.

Make Pharmacy staff a priority for covid vaccination, Pharmacies are deemed essential and the staff are often exposed to poorly people. The staff on pharmacy counters should be included amongst the early receivers of the vaccine., To ensure pharmacies remain open for the public to receive medication

Give parents/teachers the option for children to resit the school year., Help the children who are struggling with home schooling who are up to a year behind classmates, this could in the form of longer school days to ensure the curriculum is understood,for those that are far behind and struggling offer them the choice of resitting the year., This needs to be addressed as after this 3rd lockdown, children will have missed nearly off school, being educated the bare minimum through home learning as it's very hard to get a child to pay attention and concentrate as much as they would in an academic setting

Prohibit contracting private organisations for Covid-19 vaccination programme, All contracts related to the Covid-19 vaccine programme should only be awarded to Public Sector companies with experience and expertise in that field. The Government should prohibit contracts to private organisations., To avoid delay, corruption and cronyism.

Vaccinate all teachers against COVID-19 before reopening schools, Legislate that a school must have vaccinated all its teachers against COVID-19 before it can reopen, Teachers are the most vulnerable of front line workers dealing with children particularly secondary schools

Government to give significant payrise to all NHS staff on the frontline, Provide more support to NHS staff and frontline workers through this COVID pandemic who have been working long shifts, who are mentally tired and exhausted, who have lost colleagues to COVID and have families of their own., Politicians have been quick to give praise for the exemplary work of the NHS at the time of this crisis with clapping during the first wave of the Virus. Yet that has done nothing for all NHS staff who are in the midst of the second wave with more cases, more deaths and  more colleagues going of sick. 

If the government want to show real support to NHS provide more funding and wage increases for all.

4 weeks gap not 12!!! 
Fully Vaccinate and protect NHS staff against Covid 19., Reduce the gap between COVID 19 vaccinations. Fully Protect the NHS. Help them to save lives., The NHS deserve full protection from COVID 19. One dose is only 53% effective. 12 weeks is too long to wait for the second dose. We need FULL protection, 4 week interval not 12!!

Allow pharmacies to deliver Covid-19 vaccinations., Community pharmacists have the resources and supply chains to deliver vaccinations quickly and effectively, as they do now for flu. Govt should utilise their expertise to accelerate the Covid-19 vaccination programme. This will relieve the pressure on GPs and allow them to treat the sick., As above.

Prioritise telecoms and utilities engineers for the vaccination, As a engineer I can go into up-to 10 different houses every day to fix there services that is over upto 40 chances of catching COVID and potentially passing it on to people as I might not know I have it and might just be a carrier,

Both COVID Vaccines within 21-28 days for NHS and Social care workers., Fully protect Front facing NHS and social care staff from COVID 19., Being among the highest risk category, and at the greatest level of exposure. NHS staff are now expected to continue to care for patients and deliver a mass vaccination programme. 
Under these circumstances, They are offered only 1 dose of the vaccine for around 53% protection. No data is published or available to suggest what level of protection is expected between the first and second dose with a 12 week gap. This demographic needs FULL protection. Even if the one dose offers “some” protection, they may still have illness and time off as a result. This would leave the NHS struggling yet again due to staffing levels.
They need full protection 2 doses 21-28 days apart as per trail, so they can continue protecting the health of the nation.

Gavin Williamson's position is untenable-remove him from office immediately., There should be a change in the cabinet office of Education Secretary and Gavin should be removed immediately. He is incompetent and has lost trust with all in education., The current education secretary has bumbled along during this crisis for far too long. Inadequate and improper government guidance to Headteachers and schools, shocking support given, over promised and under-delivered. He has lost the confidence of the profession, schools, Ofsted, parents and most importantly the children themselves. Teachers and schools are doing their best and Mr Williamson is undermining their ongoing efforts.

Include Covid 19 Testers in the frontline worker priority group for vaccination, Include Covid 19 testers in the frontline priority group for vaccination in line with other NHS workers, in order to protect the lives of those most at risk of exposure to the disease. Omission of testing staff means they now wait until over-50s have been vaccinated, which is likely to take months., Those who test for the coronavirus will not be vaccinated alongside other frontline health staff, they are among the most exposed to the virus, with many encountering hundreds of symptomatic people a day. This is an unfair. putting us at extra when protection is available and being given out to other frontline workers in similar roles.

Recognise COVID-19 testers as a priority to be vaccinated, To recognise the COVID-19 testers as front line workers who deal with suspected covid patients daily and provide them with the vaccine as a priority just as you do with nurses and Drs and other health care professionals., The COVID-19 test centres (assisted testers such as Boots, Sodexo etc.) are in contact with suspected Covid-19 patients daily and carry out the test on any individual over 12 who may have the symptoms of Covid. These assisted testers are at risk daily from exposure to Covid from all those that they must swab. Even though there is PPE involved, the assisted testers must be close in space to these individuals to perform the test adequately and come into contact with them for this reason.

All key/critical workers to be given COVID-19 vaccine. To help aid the economy., All key workers to be given the Covid-19 vaccine as soon as possible to not only get the economy up and running properly but to also allow all children the chance to have a good education now as they are already so far behind. We need to keep educating children they are the future of this country., Vaccine for all key workers on priority list to get vaccinated.(Education and childcare workers, Key public services, Food and other necessary goods workers including shop assistance, Transport and border workers, Public safety and national security, Utilities, communication and financial services)

Çhange the laws for carrying a knife in the uk for adults and under 18s., In the year ending June 2019, there were 22,306 disposals given for possession of a knife or offensive weapon. Juveniles (aged 10-17) were the offenders in 20% of cases. London recorded the highest rate of 179 offences involving a knife per 100,000 population. There is no deterrent!, Current laws are offenders aged 18 or over would be sentenced to a minimum six months' custodial sentence and a maximum 4 years .
For those aged 16 or 17 the minimum sentence is a detention and training order of at least four months. 
This is not enough. Knife crime in the UK is rising rapidly. We have to protect our children. Change the legislation and make it a detterant. 8 years minimum for carrying a knife in public. This needs sorting out! We want change, now. Protect our children.

Give COVID-19 vaccines 24 hours a day to the most at risk and frontline workers, After the Coronavirus Briefing today (11/01/21) when the question was asked if the vaccine could be given 24/7, Matt Hancock said if both the person doing the vaccine and the person receiving the vaccine would prefer for it to be offered 24 hours a day then then they’ll consider it, If the vaccines are given 24 hours a day then the categories can be got through quicker (more people will be vaccinated) and we can hopefully put an end to this pandemic

If the UK can get enough supply of the vaccines and people are vaccinated 24 hours a day then the people that are going to receive their first dose of the vaccine by the middle of February can receive their second dose sooner meaning they’ll have more immunity sooner than they currently will do

NHS/care staff to be given priority COVID vaccine; 2 doses at 21/28 day interval, Prioritise NHS/Care staff for the COVID vaccination in line with the license - 2 doses at no longer than licensed interval., The COVID vaccinations are licensed to be given in 2 doses, with a 21 or 28 day interval. NHS staff were consented for the vaccination on this basis but now the second dose interval has been delayed until 12 weeks - this is now “off license”. For the general population who can shield and distance this may be appropriate but NHS staff who must walk towards the risk for the benefit of others are at disproportionate risk. Using NHS staff to shore up the presentation of this policy is an abuse.

Do not rollout Covid-19 vaccine passports, We want the Government to commit to not rolling out any e-vaccination status/immunity passport to the British public. Such passports could be used to restrict the rights of people who have refused a Covid-19 vaccine, which would be unacceptable., On Dec 14th 2020, Nadhim Zahawi MP said 'there are no plans for vaccine passports'. He continues to deny the Government has plans despite reports that people who have received the Covid-19 vaccine will be offered a passport proving they have been vaccinated as part of a government-funded trial.
 
The Government must be completely clear to the public about the use of vaccine passports & their intentions, which will undoubtedly affect societal cohesion & effect the economic recovery of Great Britain this year & into 2022.

Reverse the vaccine program, start vaccinate secondary school children up to OAP, Reverse the vaccine program, start vaccinating secondary school children, as in the words of the PM, schools act as vectors for transmission.Then move up through the age groups to OAPs., This will allow school children to continue there education, free up parents to work without interruption to get the economy going again and start to get life back to normal. Vaccinating the younger generations could prevent spreading. The young generation are the countries future, they are nearly a full year behind on their education.

Make all sanitary products free!, I want sanitary products to be free! There are hundreds of females who can't afford them and if contraception can be free why can't sanitary products be! We are not in control., We can't control a menstrual cycle unless we get contraception and some women don't want contraception. Condoms are free and sex is a choice, a menstrual cycle isn't.

Stop Medical Discrimination & Forced Treatment, As above.

Following the Nuremberg Code, Freedom of informed health choice.

Ensure second Covid vaccine doses are delivered within 3 weeks of first doses., The Government must ensure that all Covid vaccinations that are reliant on double doses are delivered according to their manufacturer's specifications. For the Pfizer/BioNTech vaccine and the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine, that means delivering second doses within 3 weeks of first doses., The manufacturers of both vaccines, particularly the Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine, have stated their vaccines were trialled with 3 weeks between the first and second doses, not 12 weeks, as is the Government's current recommended timeline. The manufacturers also stated they do not recommend increasing the time between doses for fear of reduced effectiveness. If vaccine effectiveness falls as a result of the Government extending the gap between doses, it would be an egregious disservice to the public.

Increase research funding into the use of Ivermectin as a treatment for Covid-19, In light of recent evidence that the antiparasitic drug Ivermectin could potentially reduce deaths from Covid-19, the Government should provide more funding for research into its efficacy as a treatment.,

Give all Care Home residents their 2nd vaccine dose now, not in 3 months., Forgotten at the beginning of the pandemic & left struggling throughout. It is imperative that Care Home residents should not have to wait 3 months or more to get their second dose of vaccine. They have been through enough. This is vital to stop increased mental health problems as well as physical., It is the Govt responsibilty to serve every citizen & those in Care Homes have suffered the most. Lockdown has had an extremely detrimental affect on their wellbeing, mental health & physical capabilities. The continued anguish for their families is only made worse now by the stalling of the 2nd dose of vaccine. They MUST be priority and get both doses on time as advised.

Prioritise all emergency / key workers for Covid 19 vaccinations., Allow emergency / key workers to be prioritised for vaccinations to allow them to carry out their duties in protecting the public and helping to create a safer UK. 

Allow any surplus vaccinations that are not used to be redeployed through available unallocated / unattended bookings., "Key worker" status has been referred to throughout the pandemic, it demonstrates the importance of the roles that are considered crucial to keeping the country running safely, namely; NHS staff, social care workers, schools and nurseries, police officer, prisons and probations, legal professionals, religious staff, journalists, government staff, delivery workers, supermarket staff, armed forces and MOD, firefighters, transport workers, gas and electric, financial....
Consider key workers now!

To put the Knife Crime sentence longer, We would Like to change the sentence for a knife Crime and to make it longer this would decrease the knife crime., knife crime at the highest record level in the past ten years, this is in the whole in the Uk starting in 2010 and 11 there were 86 stabbings in 2013/2014 there was 76 meaning that the level went down than in 2016/2017 there were 118 stabs. Then in 2017/2020, there were 164 stabs
Security officers should get full sick pay, Give security officers full sick pay not statutory sick pay,

Offer free private health care if waiting time exceeds 3 months for transgender, There is an enormous waiting time for transgender people a lot of transgender people has to wait 3 years or more to get vital treatment. The government should offer free private health care for transgender people such as hormones, vital surgeries and other support until the NHS can offer them help., Transgender people have to wait years for vital treatment in order to ensure they feel comfortable with their body through hormone replacement therapy. A lot of clinics from the NHS only takes in patients from 2017.

The government shouldn't let transgender people suffer from not being able to access the necessary medication. Which can lead to a higher risk of suicide, self-harm and other mental health issues.

Change covid-19 second dose vaccination protocol from 12 weeks to 3 weeks, Please revert the covid-19 second dose to the advised schedule from Pfizer and WHO from 12 weeks apart to 3 weeks apart., Please revert the covid-19 second dose to the advised schedule from Pfizer and WHO from 12 weeks apart to 3 weeks apart. 
Please give the people the best immunity outcome from the vaccine within the time frame advised by Pfizer and WHO.

Reduce the gap between COVID-19 vaccinations to 4-6 weeks from 12 weeks., The current position of NHS England is to enforce a position of no second doses of COVID-19 vaccine until 12 weeks have passed from the first dose. There is no room for clinical discretion. The existing evidence supports a much shorter interval to give good efficacy at person level., The argument to support the current stance is based on balance of population benefit versus risk in covering more people with a first dose. Evidence is lacking to support either decision at a population level. Emerging evidence suggests protection is less than expected in the intervening period between doses if the second dose is delayed. This might result in increased risk even at population level compared to shortening the interval. Providing no choice regarding second dose timing is unethical

Require all teachers and TAs to have basic mental health training, I want the Government to make it mandatory for all teachers and teaching assistants to have basic training in mental health so they can be able to understand and assist young people struggling. Lack of education is a big problem.,

Prioritise all who qualify for a blue light card to get the covid-19 vaccination, Prison officers, police, firefighters and everyone on the list that is eligible for the blue light card to be prioritised to get the covid-19 vaccination, the forgotten public/private services that have continued to work throughout the pandemic and cannot work from home, Every day we have dealt with suspected and confirmed cases of covid-19, we are the forgotten services that would benefit from the vaccination. Yes the NHS are doing an amazing job,but not all NHS workers save lives, some have the luxury to work from home and haven’t set foot inside a hospital, but because they work for the NHS they are eligible to receive the vaccination. The prison service, courts, firefighters etc would never refuse to help anyone if they were tested positive to covid. This vaccination would/could give us some protection in an already stressful and sometimes volatile environment

Give those home schooling an increase in child benefit for duration of lockdown., I along with many parents would appreciate an increase in child benefit to help with the cost of home schooling during lockdown, this would assist in the payment of schooling supplies such as paper, pencils, printer ink etc. And also extra food which would've been provided to the children by school, I feel as we are all suffering some restrictions with regards to earnings the expenditure we're all enduring has significantly increased! With our children being home schooled, personally I have 3 extra mouths to feed at lunch time and 3 lots of school supplies to pay out for in order to assist our children as best we can on their educational journey at home. It is an expensive undertaking and is forcing more children closer to the poverty line with regards to their home environment.

Physical proof of Pre/Settled status for EU nationals in UK, The Government needs to introduce a physical proof of Pre/Settled status for EU nationals in UK (similar to resident card)., There are many EU nationals complaining they were stopped on the border checks in UK airports asked by the authorities to prove their status physically and the letter which a person receive confirming he/she's been granted with it is clearly say that "this letter is not proof of your status in the UK". Also if at some point EU national living in the UK decides to go back to his country of origin or another EU country and whants to bennefit from his social security rights, he needs a physical evidence.

Vaccinate British Citizens living in the UK  FIRST with the Covid 19 vaccine, To assure British citizens living in the UK that they will receive vaccinations FIRST and before others from other countries. To vaccinate the UK population FIRST and ENTIRELY before sending any vaccine abroad., Protect British Citizens and taxpayers first in relation to the Covid 19 vaccination programme

Increase funding for NHS transgender services, Currently in England trans people are regularly having to choose between waiting years to get the treatment that they need through the NHS, and paying upwards of £8000-10000 to go privately. This is unacceptable and can cause of exacerbate mental health issues., The waiting times for some gender clinics range from 24 months at the low end to 60 months at the top end. This is completely horrendous, as things such as hormone treatment and surgery are literally life-saving procedures for many. Funding for infrastructure needs to be put in place to support transgender people looking to transition through the NHS and shorten these wait times. Many cannot afford to pay £8000-£10000 to go privately and should not be forced to.

Do not require deed polls to be enrolled to serve as a proof of name change, Currently the government is considering changes to how deed polls are processed. In its response to a previous petition it says it intends to amend guidance so that only enrolled deed polls are accepted as a proof of name change.
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/300705
, Currently publicly enrolling deed polls is optional. Requiring them to be enrolled in this way will be harmful to abuse survivors and transgender people, amongst others. Doing this would make it a lot easier for abuse victims to be found by their abusers again – many change their name to get away from them. It could also potentially be used for hate crime purposes against trans people as you must declare your address on a deed poll. This is a dangerous precedent.

Give war medals to the families of the soldiers that were shot at dawn in WW1, Many of the soldiers that were shot at dawn in WW1 did not qualify for war medals or had them taken off them. Given that 306 were pardoned in 2006 we feel it is only right that their medals get reinstated, We feel an injustice was done by refusing or revoking medals for these soldiers. They were victims of the war too.

Once priority groups in the UK are vaccinated redirect Covid-19 vaccines abroad, Once priority groups, including the vulnerable and those aged over 50, are vaccinated, we must redirect our vaccines for export to low and middle-income countries, so they can vaccinate the vulnerable in their countries., Nobody is safe until everybody is safe, at the global level.
 
This is a global virus that requires a global community response. It would be a catastrophic moral failure for us to vaccinate our young and healthy, before vulnerable people in other countries have received their jabs.
 
Let this be a moment where the UK steps forward as a world leader, as we've always done throughout our history. We cannot retreat into vaccination protectionism.

Hold a referendum on UK membership of the Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP), UK government must hold a referendum on UK accession to CPTPP., In 2019 General Election the UK government received an electoral mandate for taking back sovereignty.

However, denies the British people the ability to express their opinion on CPTPP membership. Sovereignty will be lost, as rules will be decided by foreign governments. This is results in a democratic deficit. 

The UK had in 1975 & 2016 referendums on joining & leaving the EU, as the government of the day felt that British people's opinion was necessary. Accession to CPTPP is no different.

Ban vote counting machines in elections, Ban the unnecessary and additional use of vote counting machines and software in our democratic election process.

The Government and Parliament should ensure that all elections will be conducted on the trusted hand counted paper ballot process that has been successful for hundreds of years., Concerns include proprietary software running non-transparent source code, concerns over weighted mathematical algorithms, technical security & operational vulnerabilities and reduced technical and knowledge gap oversight.

In the 2021 London & Scottish elections, private international companies have been contracted to deliver end-to-end services, software and technical infrastructure for the electronic counting of votes. Undoubtedly lobbying for broader use will ensue.

Increase government funding for the provision of social housing., Not only is it hard for many people to compete in the housing market, but to make things worse there is also a lack of social housing around the UK. Therefore, there should be a far greater number of social housing in the UK., At its core, homelessness is caused by inequality resulting in people's inability to compete in the housing market.Approximately one in five people in the UK are living in poverty, this is truly shocking. It is estimated that there are 280,000 homeless people in the UK, I am campaigning to attempt to dramatically reduce this figure.

Repeal EU law which protects vaccine manufacturers from liability, Remove the protections given to companies such as Pfizer, giving them immunity from being sued by patients in the event of any complications., Stop UK vaccine damage payments which has paid out over £74 million since 1978.

Get all police officers vaccinated first, Please get all police officers vaccinated first. There are loads of reasons for this push to get police officers vaccinated first because they can be considered as super spreaders of the virus, Get all police officers vaccinated first. There are loads of reasons for this push to get police officers vaccinated first because they can be considered as super spreaders of the virus

Make being non-binary a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010, Currently, under the UK 2010 Equality Act, non-binary individuals are not explicitly protected, leaving their protection up to individual court rulings. Many institutions use binarist (e.g. 'he/she' instead of 'they') language, and no recourse is available to non-binary individuals., In the UK, there are currently an estimated 266,600 non-binary individuals. Many institutions, including public bodies, still use gendered language in documents, and news companies use 'he/she' instead of inclusive alternatives. Trans populations have the lowest life satisfaction compared to LGBTQ+ average, and many TGNB individuals have suffered with mental health issues. The government needs to step in, and make being non-binary a protected characteristic.
Open schools and universities, Vaccinate teachers, Children’s mental and physical health

Introduce a minimum sentence for carrying a knife, equal to carrying a firearm, There should be a statutory minimum sentence for those found carrying a knife, the same as if carrying a firearm. With the reported 33% increase in knife crime since 2011 it is clear that there needs to be serious consideration for the punishment for those carrying offensive weapons., The cycle needs to stop and the only way positive results will become evident and we will see a reduction in young murders is if we tighten up on sentencing for those carrying a knife.

If a young person is caught with a knife and it is their first offence they potentially have no further punishment with the current policy’s around knife crime in place. Unlike those caught with a firearm. How many of those have been let off lightly for knife crimes have then gone on to re offend and use a knife

Lift the smoking ban on AFC Harrogate., The new intakes in AFC Harrogate are feel forced not to smoke because of the camp rule that was enforced in 2020, Help lift this ban so junior soldiers can feel like they have their rights back to smoke

I would like you to make it illegal to have dogs off lead in public areas., I am a professional dog trainer. On a daily basis I see dogs/people being attacked by off lead dogs. You cannot walk around a park etc without someone’s dog running over. 
Friendly or not, the dog on the lead may not be. Since lockdown this issue has got worse and has become incredibly dangerous., I love my dogs being off lead however safety comes first. If it was made law for dogs to be on the lead in public areas, people could actually go for walks without the fear of dogs running over to them and their dogs. This would dramatically reduce dog bites and make it far easier to train dogs. 
With the dramatic increase in people purchasing dogs, there is no better time.

Create a national memorial for Key Workers lost to COVID, To fund a national memorial that commemorates the lives of the essential key workers of the United Kingdom who have tragically lost their lives during the COVID pandemic, A national memorial requires funding and this should be derived from the public purse in recognition of the tragic sacrifice of so many in support of the national response to COVID

Lobby for Police Officers to be vaccinated against Covid-19., Place Police Officers (as Key Frontline workers) at the front of the queue to be vaccinated against Covid-19., In the case of Police Officers; they operate each day in a volatile and changing environment, endangering themselves to keep us, the general public, safe and are still waiting to be vaccinated, while in some parts of the UK, vaccinations for Covid-19 are being offered to people as young as 50 years of age. 
The Central and Local Governments are failing in their duty, as employers to keep their employees namely Frontline Police Officers safe.

Make all types of Transgender Surgeries Essential on the NHS and resume them now, I would like the government to allow all transgender health care on the NHS to open back up and resume the service, this is regarding all hospitals in the UK that perform surgeries on trans people and all types of surgeries, Brighton Nuffield Hospital and St Peters Andrology Hospital London etc, Transgender Rights are really important for safety of peoples mental health, well-being and self esteem, these surgeries are life saving and should not be put on hold, this is life threatening, acute rates of suicide have been high in trans people not getting the treatment they need, its not fair how these people are still having to wait years for treatment, it's only fair these people are able to get their surgeries while they are still in their early 20s, please prioritize this as essential.

Change the 'do not resuscitate' orders on patients with learning difficulties, Remove the 'do not resuscitate' instructions for the nhs that are in place for people with learning difficulties so that they are treated the same as everyone else., Mencap reports that the DNACPR notices have been issued to people with learning difficulties despite them not being 'too frail to cope with car' which is the normal sideline for when a DNACPR would be put in place. this is even more shocking as there is not planning to give people with learning difficulties priority for vaccines as they are at a higher risk of contracting and dying for the virus. NHS figures show that young people with covid-19 are 30 times more likely to die than their peers.

Make MHRA Yellow Card reporting mandatory for all medical professionals, The Government should make the MHRA’s Yellow Card reporting system mandatory for medical professionals to complete whenever they identify or are made aware of an adverse reaction., All yellow card reports must also be sent to the responsible pharmaceutical company immediately.  
 
This will ensure that medical professionals have a responsibility to report, with appropriate sanctions if they fail to do so. It should increase reporting and help improve patient safety and confidence.

Kristian Johnsons Law. Life sentences for Death by Careless & Dangerous Driving., Kristian Johnson was killed by a drink driver who was more than twice the legal limit. His killer was sentenced to 3 years for Causing Death by Careless Driving and is eligible for release from prison in 18 months. We want appropriate justice. Appropriate justice is a life sentence for these crimes., Kristian's killer was convicted of causing death by 'Careless Driving' rather than 'Dangerous Driving' - a crime which carries a maximum sentence of just 5 years. 18 months in prison is not justice for killing someone and is unlikely to deter future drink-driving. The sentence does not fit the crime. The impact to the lives of the victim’s family is incomprehensible and a sentence of 18 months further damages the family. Kristian was 24, of good health and should have had a full life ahead of him. Instead it was cut tragically short. 

We are asking the Government to increase the maximum penalty to life sentences for death by careless driving as they promised in October 2017 and those convicted should serve a minimum of 15 years.

Increase funding for Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services, Provide more funding to CAMHS (child and adolescent mental health services). Additional funding should be used for better training and more staff, as well as more sites to make it more accessible., More funding will help there be more training and therefore more CAMHS workers which will shorten the waiting lists which are currently very high. This is crucial due to the high rates of suicide attempts by teenagers and children. Better training should improve the quality of treatment/help so they will not need to stay in CAMHS as long, which will further help with waiting lists.

Rejoin the EU. Reverse the previous decision., Reverse a previous perverse vote.,

Make employers that require Covid-19 vaccination liable for vaccine damages, During the COVID pandemic, the implementation of the vaccine rollout was voluntary and vaccines were rolled out quickly for emergency use. Manufacturers have been granted immunity from liability for damages caused by the vaccines, although compensation is available from the Government., A number of employers have started requiring staff to undertake the medical procedure of becoming vaccinated in order to continue employment.
 
As this means the employer asserting themselves over an employee's personal autonomy, responsibility is being assumed by the business/ establishment, and they should be held liable for any and all damages proven to be caused by being vaccinated.
 
Freedom of choice and personal autonomy is a human right and if employees are required to be vaccinated to continue their employment then there should be clear rights to financial compensation for any adverse consequences.

Automatically Issue Covid 19 Immunity Passports, During the first wave of the C19 pandemic, Nature.com collected over 12,000 responses from scientists, who expressed their opinions on “immunity passports” as an instrument to lessen the impact of the crisis. Scientists perceived immunity passports as favourable for public health., The idea of immunity passports,’ is being discussed with increasing seriousness in the UK, Italy, Germany Chile, Estonia, Israel and the USA. We strive for Equality for All. Therefore, to avoid discrimination against those that have contracted and recovered from C19, their immunity should be treated equally as those that has been vaccinated. The UK citizens that have recovered totals 6,692,234 persons out of 7,771,294.

Make it illegal for a lone police officer to arrest an unaccompanied woman, In light of recent events involving police officers engaging in criminal activities, and having struggled to think of any way I would have behaved differently if faced by a similar situation, it should be made illegal for a lone police officer to be able to arrest a woman who is on her own., Murders of women occur on a far too frequent basis however this is the first time where I haven't been able to say I would have done anything differently to what a victim did. People should be able to trust police officers, but have limited options for protecting themselves if confronted by a police officer. We believe the only way to protect women is for lone officers being prevented from being able to arrest a woman who is by themselves. Two police officers must be present for such an arrest.

Review how the rights of trans and non-binary people are respected in sport, The Government should commission a review to look at how the rights of trans and non-binary people are, and can be better, respected in sport., Recently released guidance from a group of sports bodies concluded that ‘inclusion of transgender people into female sport cannot be balanced' with 'inclusion, fairness and safety in gender-affected sport where there is meaningful competition.' The Government must act to ensure that governing bodies are instead encouraged to prioritise trans and non-binary people’s right to inclusion.
 
The Olympic Charter states ‘The practice of sport is a human right'. Being trans or non-binary is not a choice, and every trans and non-binary person has the right to play sport, without fear of prejudice or discrimination.

Review arrangements for off duty police officers to hold warrant cards, In light of recent events the Government should review whether it is appropriate that police officers have access to their warrant cards when they are off duty.,

Require a female police officer to be present when a woman is arrested, To help make women feel safer and have trust in the police again, they should only be arrested with a female police officer present., If there was a law that women can only be arrested with a female police officer present, recent tragedies could have been prevented. This could also give women more confidence going forward about trusting police. This law should apply to all police officers not just plain clothes officers, because anyone can get a fake police uniform.

Require a uniformed police officer be present for arrest or detention, The Government should make it a requirement for an officer in uniform to be present in order for an individual to be arrested or detained. Police officers should be visible for the safety of the general public., Currently police officers can arrest a civilian while otherwise off duty, and out of uniform, and only have to show their warrant card. 

The Met has advised people to ask "searching questions" which puts the responsibility onto civilians and not the officer. Just showing a police warrant card not only makes it easy for someone to impersonate an officer, but also for a legitimate officer to abuse their powers. Public safety is at risk.

Give people the right to make a phone call before arrest, In light of recent tragic events involving serving police officers, we urge the Government to grant all individuals the right to make a call before they are arrested to inform their next of kin or similar of the impending arrest, arresting officer's name and police station they will be taken to., 
If people had the right to be able to legally request to inform next of kin of their impending 'arrest', name the officer and tell them where they are going to be taken to, they could be saved from heinous crimes.

Require all arrests of women to be conducted by a female officer, Introduce legislation to protect women against rogue male police officers whereby all physical contact between a female civilian and a police officer is conducted by female police officers., To protect female civilians against brutality from male police officers such as inappropriate touching, violence, rape and murder.

Offer the 2nd dose of a COVID vaccine to all 16 and 17 year olds, We know that many services and opportunities are reopening, but some only for double vaccinated people. This discriminates against 16 and 17 year olds, most of whom have only been offered one dose. They should be offered a second dose, so they can be fully vaccinated.,

Make possessing "date rape" drugs an offence with a mandatory 10-year sentence, The Government should create a new criminal offence of carrying a substance that can be potentially used for "date rape", with a mandatory 10-year prison sentence., There has been a lot of media attention particularly but not exclusively around violence against women. Carrying a weapon is illegal whether or not it is used. It could be argued that carrying a "date rape" drug is a weapon being carried with intent. The victims are left with a life sentence of trauma. Young people, particularly students, who are away from home and new to going to entertainment venues are vulnerable. A hard line on this is needed as a stance against this awful violent crime.

Make vaccination mandatory for all MPs and members of the House of Lords., Bring in Mandatory vaccination for all MPs, Members of the House of Lords and all their staff., With crisis after crisis gripping our nation the death or serious illness of an MP or other government officials could deepen the fear felt by the public. Vaccination would reduce the risk of this. This would also show the public the Government are confident in the vaccines.

Offer 2nd Covid-19 vaccination to all 12-17 year olds, I want a 2nd Covid vaccination dose made available to all 12-17 year-olds, so that this age group can travel abroad without having to face restrictions many countries are placing on travellers who are not fully vaccinated., There is presently no way of getting a 2nd Covid jab for 12-17 year-olds in the UK, unless they are clinically vulnerable or live with such a person. This means that most of them cannot travel abroad without facing restrictions abroad. Other countries do not consider a single dose for this age group 'fully vaccinated'. Consequently, 12-17 year-olds are effectively excluded from short stay visits with family abroad, educational trips and exchange programmes with other countries.

Do not make covid-19 or flu vaccine a condition of deployment for NHS workers, Do not implement any plans to make the covid-19 or flu vaccine a condition of deployment for frontline NHS workers., This is an abhorrent proposal given the many potential side effects of the covid-19 vaccine given in the NHS yellow card data as well as the fact that taking the vaccine doesn't fully prevent people from getting or transmitting covid 19. People should not be moved out of frontline roles because they choose not to take part in this medical procedure.

Increase dedicated funding for police to tackle Pet Abduction, The Government must ensure the police are provided with more funding to help them tackle pet abduction. While the sentencing law has changed, only 2% of pet thieves are caught and prosecuted. More funding needs to be available to help with enforcement. More dedicated police officers are needed., While we appreciate the new sentencing law, only 2% of Pet Abduction thieves are being caught and prosecuted. Funding could allow a dedicated officer in every Police force and District, for example, creating more time and resources to be made available for the victims of Pet Abduction. This should then deter the thieves to commit such crimes. Victims of Pet Abduction have been having to chase up leads themselves, which is then endangering their lives. We need more support from the police in such a difficult period of our lives.
Death by knife crime punishable by whole life sentence, If a death is caused by knife crime it should be punishable by whole life prison term, Change the law

Require licensed venues to introduce anti-spiking policies, and fund training, The Government should:
- require licensed venues to introduce dedicated policies to tackle drink spiking and comply with local authority requests e.g. CCTV
- require local authorities to revoke the licenses of venues which fail to do so
- fund training for venues on how to spot and stop spiking, Spiking, in which drugs or alcohol are covertly added to another person's drink in the attempt to inebriate them, is a serious crime that surely violates the Licensing Act and licensing objectives and the expected safety of individuals within their care. Funding must be made available for training for venues and their staff to undertake training on how and when to spot spiking, and recognize their responsibility in assisting with medical support and police prosecution of the offender. Victims must have the agency to report venues which do not follow these objectives.

Make 'None of the Above' appear an option to select on all ballot papers, Ensure None of the Above appears on future ballot papers in all future elections.., A healthy democracy should require dissent and an easy way to show it for people unsatisfied with all the candidates available on their ballot papers rather than people refusing to vote outright which provides limited indication of dissatisfaction.

Two year minimum custodial sentence for 16 yrs + carrying a knife, Since 2015, people aged 16 to 17 years old caught in possession of a knife face a minimum of 4 month detention and training order and adults from 18 years up will face a minimum 6 month custodial sentence. It appears that hasn't been able to deter people from carrying a knife., I personally know the devastating impact it causes. As we move forward, increasing the minimum sentencing would send a strong message to future offenders that it's not worth destroying their own life and somebody else's.
 
Too many families have lost loved ones to this senseless crime. We must change the sentencing to help our future generations.

Publish daily figures of all deaths within 28 days of receiving a Covid vaccine, Start to report daily on the number of deaths which occur within 28 days of receiving a Covid vaccine, alongside daily reporting on deaths which occur 28 days within positive PCR Covid test., There seem to be a lot of vaccine hesitancy, slowing down vaccine uptake, due to adverse side effects of the vaccine. Reporting deaths post vaccination alongside deaths after testing positive for Covid-19 should help regain Government trust and could speed up vaccine rollout.

Increase daily rates for low-ranked Army Reserve soldiers, Currently, British Army reserve forces Recruits, Privates and Lance Corporals receive day rates that work out below the national minimum wage.
 
This needs to change!
 
The Government should increase day rates for low-ranked Army Reservists so the hourly equivalent is at least the minimum wage., As per regulations, a reserve soldier has to complete a minimum of eight working hours of service a day in order to meet the requirement to be paid a full day's wage. Any less than this will be deducted from half to a quarter based on hours worked.
 
Daily rates are as follows:
 
Recruits (in initial training); £40.13 per day
Private: £51.22 per day
Lance Corporal: £68.61 per day
 
Any of the amounts above divided by eight will result in a number below the current minimum wage.

Explore criminal proceedings against the Government relating to covid deaths., I want Parliament to acknowledge that many deaths could have been avoided and ask the Director of Public Prosecutions to explore the option of criminal proceedings. To date over 150,000 deaths have been attributed to Covid and many could have been avoided if the Prime Minister  took prompt action., Whilst a Public Inquiry has been announced the timescale and it’s powers remain unknown.  Therefore an urgent review of the criminal liability is needed by the Director of Public Prosecutions

Recognise natural immunity for covid 19, Recognise natural antibody’s for covid and give free antibody tests, Natural immunity has always been far superior to vaccinations . Why should a person be forced to have a vaccination they do not need

Prohibit employers from requiring staff to be vaccinated against Covid-19, Make it illegal for any employer to mandate vaccination for its employees. This should apply to all public sector (including the NHS, armed forces, care workers), third sector and all private sector., We believe making vaccination a condition of employment undermines the principle of informed consent. All British people should have the right to bodily autonomy and must never be coerced into receiving a medical intervention they may not want.
 
Any medical intervention must always be with properly informed consent (awareness of risks vs benefits) and be free of coercion (whether explicit or implicit).

Fund D-Dimer blood clot tests for use in covid-19 vaccination centres, The Government should fund the NHS to provide D-Dimer tests for blood clotting at covid-19 vaccination centres., According to the Government Yellow Card data over 19,000 people have reported a suspected blood disorder reaction following a dose of the vaccine, and there are reports of people suffering from headaches and strokes/heart issues. The Government should ensure that adequate testing, observation and follow up are provided for those who take it.

Revoke immunity from prosecution for sovereigns or other heads of State, Legislation granting immunity from prosecution to heads of state should be revoked. People should be able to be held to account for their actions regardless of whether they are a head of state or not.,

Exempt NHS and emergency workers from standard rate income tax, We want to support frontline personnel. We want the Government to support those Nurses, Junior Doctors, Paramedics, Firefighters, Police officers who perform dangerous and stressful duties to support the wider population in keeping us safe and well. We need the Government to look after them., These personnel risk their lives and safety to support and protect everyone in their need. Paramedics are the first to trauma, which leaves its marks on them and the nurses and doctors to follow. Police officers face death, destruction, Trauma to others and face those same risks to themselves too. Fire fighters face death and trauma on each call they attend.

Make it mandatory for every building to be accessible for wheelchairs, I would like the Government to require every building be made accessible to wheelchairs., Because everyone should be able to attend every building and society should be inclusive. I use a wheelchair and I know myself how frustrating it is. Please consider my request.

Create a Security Workers Act, We want SIA licenced staff working on the front line to be recognised in law in a similar way to the Assaults on Emergency workers Act, but covering those with a current SIA licence and working in the field of security., The UK’s security workers put their lives on the line everyday, just like police, fire and NHS personnel, They deserve the same recognition in law.
 
A survey of 1224 people found that 36% of those working in security were physically attacked on a monthly basis and 26% more frequently (weekly)
 
So, why is assault against other front line workers - such as Door supervisors and security staff working in retail - not recognised in the same way as it is for emergency workers?

Require any MP or Peer convicted of a criminal offence be removed from office, The electorate cast their vote in a reasonable expectation that the candidate is of good character. When an MP is found guilty of any criminal offence, they have shown a disregard for the law, and broken trust and shown themselves to be unfit to be an MP. The same rule should apply to Peers., We expect our MPs and Peers to be held to the highest standards. The Government should therefore pass legislation that will remove from office, any MP, or member of the house of Lords upon conviction of any criminal offence. When one shows no regard for the law, they have no place being involved in setting new laws.
 
Integrity in politics should not be optional. Convicted criminals have no place in Parliament. We the public, expect better standards of conduct to be set.

Fund increased police numbers in England and Wales, There should be more Police Beat Officers and Police Community Support Officers in all areas across the UK. At the moment there are too few police. They are a valuable resource in dealing with crime and anti-social behaviour. They are a deterrent and help to make the public feel more at ease., At the moment anti-social behaviour appears to be more visible than ever, with some people seeming to think they can do whatever they want and get away with it. They do and they are. Many are scared to come out of their homes because they get chased by gangs, some of whom carry knives and are involved in the illegal drug trade. It is unacceptable that there is fighting in broad daylight going on in town centres, muggings and stealing. The Government must take action now.

All Member of Parliament to disclose their Covid 19 vaccine status., The UK government are currently mandating care works and are going to mandate NHS works in spring 2022 into a having the Covid 19 vaccines or face loosing their jobs. It is therefore fair, right and proper that MP's disclose their vaccine status., Mandating vaccines or any medical treatment against a person will is in breach of the Nuremburg code is totally unethical and goes against peoples inalienable human rights. MP's now need to prove they are following the same rules and legislation as the rest of the people of the UK are been legal obliged to do. If the UK isn't operating under a two tear society where MP's are above the law or certain laws don't apply to them, then disclosing their Covid 19 vaccine status should be no problem.

Do not make COVID vaccination a requirement for health and social care workers, The Government should not make vaccination against COVID a requirement for frontline health and social care workers. We believe this is contrary to basic human rights to decide whether to receive medical treatment based on personal choice and conscience., Many people do not want the vaccine for a number of reasons. Also the manufacturers are indemnified from liability for any side effects arising from the taking the vaccine. It is unacceptable that health and social care workers are being required to be vaccinated in order to do their jobs, when they would not even be entitled to compensation from the manufacturers for any adverse effects.

STOP the COVID19 Vaccine becoming mandatory to all NHS workers., It is against our human rights to make the vaccine mandatory.. the public and NHS should have a choice when it comes to putting something they do not know anything about into our body. People within the NHS have their own reasons as to why they do not want the vaccine., Making the vaccine mandatory takes away our freedom of choice. If you make the vaccine mandatory to NHS workers you are most likely to lose health care workers making our NHS more understaffed. We are already overrun. And if we do not have freedom of choice it will change our opinion on the system.

Ensure all NHS staff the right to reject COVID vaccines while keeping their jobs, Protect and uphold the rights of NHS staff to work without being forced to take COVID vaccines and ensure the rights of these workers as individuals who are capable of making their own choices on vaccinations whilst observing all proven health and safety precautions in their duty, Government should not force NHS staff to take vaccines they have decided not to, just to ensure they can keep a job. 
These NHS workers are valued members of the service and should be trusted to make their own choices on such matters!
The NHS app should include details of Booster vaccinations, Require the Ministry of Health to adapt the NHS App to include all Booster vaccinations.,

Set up a national harms reporting scheme for non-pharmacological treatments, The Government should set up a national reporting scheme, similar to the MHRA’s Yellow Card scheme, to allow patients in receipt of non-pharmacological treatments on the NHS to report suspected harms., Although patients do currently have the right to make a complaint to their NHS provider if they are harmed by a treatment, vulnerable patients can be reluctant to use this service in case it impacts their subsequent care. A centralised system should allow greater anonymity and oversight.

Make non-binary a legally recognised gender identity, To be able to legally identify as non-binary in the same way cis people identify as male or female. And to be able to have non-binary on your passport instead of male or female., To make people in the uk more comfortable when go through airports and any other legal situations. As people who identify as non-binary often feel uncomfortable about being referred to as a binary gender.

Increase Minimum Sentence for Assaulting Emergency Workers to Two Years Prison, Assaults on Emergency workers are all to common and there is no excuse for assaulting those who are serving and protecting the community and us. For example Hospital Emergency Centers where staff are abused and attacked, and 999 emergency Ambulances attacked when they respond., Including of course Police Officers, Prison Officers and staff of other emergency services. There must be a deterrent to stop this, if people knew that by assaulting them in any way would attract a minimum 2 year prison sentence it should make people think twice.
 
We demand that our Emergency workers get the protection that they deserve when performing their duties for all of us, they deserve better protection from the Establishment for what they do.

Don't offer covid-19 vaccine to 5-11 year olds until phase 3 trials complete, Do not roll out covid-19 vaccines to 5-11 year olds until phase 3 trials for that age are complete & there is a clear risk benefit analysis for the individual child, based on health only. They should not be vaccinated solely for the benefit of the wider population., The Pfizer trial for 5-11 year olds was only on 4.5k children & they were followed for 2 months after the 2nd dose, therefore there is no long-term safety data. One study suggests an increased risk of myocarditis in teenage boys, though this is yet to be peer reviewed and is based on self-reporting of suspected symptoms in the US. We feel the current under-11s trial is too small to evaluate this risk. Children rarely get serious symptoms or die of COVID.

Make possession of child sex dolls illegal, I want the UK Government to pass legislation which makes possession of child sex dolls illegal. It is currently illegal to ship them into the UK, however it isn't illegal to own one. They can be hyper-realistic, child-sized dolls., Some research suggests that owning a child sex doll could lead to an escalation of child sexual offending.

Require schools to teach about going to prison as part of the curriculum, The Government should require schools to teach students about what is involved in going to prison, and the impact this can have on a person's life. We believe it is better to be educated about this at an early age, so people understand the risks of crimes that could result in jail., Too many people are doing the wrong thing in life, and everyone needs to be taught about the consequences of this to help improve the world, and hopefully result in fewer crimes, and fewer people in prison.

Do not make vaccination against Covid-19 mandatory, Do not under any circumstances make vaccination against Covid-19 a requirement for the public. To coerce in the form of fines or otherwise, as is being proposed in Austria, would be a grotesque violation of bodily autonomy., Anyone's body is not the property of the government. The Government must not make medical decisions for people without their explicit consent. This is a fundamental human right.
 
It doesn't matter how dangerous a virus is. We believe a government forcing people to get injections sets a far, far more dangerous precedent.

Minimum sentences and mandatory licensing for carrying a knife, The Government should require people who have a reasonable excuse to carry a knife to apply for a licence, with strict minimum sentences for carrying a knife without a licence, equivalent to those for carrying an unlicensed firearm., My son was murdered by someone who had previously been caught with a knife. This law could have prevented this happening.
 
Given the prevalence of knife crime we desperately need an intervention by means of licensing and the deterrent of a minimum sentence for carrying an unlicensed knife.
 
A deterrent is important, anyone carrying a knife may use it and cause serious harm or death.
 
The Government are not taking knife crime seriously enough, we cannot continue to bury our children, the age of stabbings is getting younger.
 
The law needs to change.

All MPs to sign their agreement to adhere to the Nuremberg Code., The Government's Chairman Oliver Dowden  has not ruled out forced vaccination to the people of the UK. This is in violation of the Nuremberg Code. 
We therefore want all of our MPs to publicly state in writing they will not violate the Nuremberg Code., Across the EU we see governments deciding on forced vaccination of their populations despite the covid vaccines waning efficacy and the fact this breaches the Nuremberg Code. 

The UK government should make it clear to the public at no point will they be willing to break the fundamental human rights as spelled out in the Nuremberg Code.

Dramatically increase funding for children’s social services, The Government should dramatically increase funding for children’s social services to try and prevent children’s deaths across the country. This should fund additional social workers and better pay, so they are better able to do their jobs, and can spot/act on signs of abuse, In 2020/21, there were over 24.8 thousand child abuse offences recorded by the police in England and Wales, an increase of 2.9 thousand offences when compared with the previous year, and a peak for this type of offence.
 
During the coronavirus outbreak the number of adults concerned about children calling the the NSPCC helpline has gone up by over 20%
 
Something dramatic needs to change.

Mandatory drug tests for all MPs, Lords & their staff, We demand to have every single member of parliament, peer and their staff be screened for illegal drugs, immediately and at random intervals. This should be in place until UK drug policy is fundamentally reformed., We believe war on drugs has be a constant and unparalleled failure. This week the Government has announced a series of new measures we believe will be ineffective at controlling the drug trade. This is the same week that it has been reported that cocaine traces have been found in the bathrooms at the Palace of Westminster.
 
Since the Government maintain strict drugs policies and refuse to recognise the value of regulating and taxing drugs and taking the power away from dealers and gangsters, let them be the first to prove they are innocent.

All UK residents to carry Identity cards, It is about time all UK residents carried identity cards, to help combat all forms of benefit fraud. To help combat voting fraud. Etc.
The military already carry them, it would help the police and Border force to combat illegal immigrants working here., It will progressively become more nessassary to introduce identity cards to all our population, to help combat crime in all forms.
It will assist  our NHS to charge non nationals for services.
Will help our immigration services and Border Guards.
It will become more accepted as time goes on.

mandatory Westminster drug tests., Make ANY government official undergo random drug tests.
Make it mandatory for members of parliament, the house of lords etc to undergo random monthly drug tests via an independant company.,

Drug testing for MPs and officials at Westminster, Following the recent detection of cocaine traces in washrooms at Westminster, MPs and public officials should be subject to random drug testing, as in countless other professions., Any representative using illicit substances cannot be expected to perform his duties responsibly.

Make it illegal to discriminate against someone based on their expressed opinion, Bodies or individuals committing such discrimination should be liable for criminal prosecution. The wronged person should have legal rights to compensation for mental suffering and financial loss.

The only exemption would be if the person had been convicted for illegally expressing their opinion., If the petition’s proposals became law then people would be protected from discrimination based on their expressed opinions.
 
This would mean that employers and businesses could not choose to discriminate, or be pressured into discriminating, against people on the basis of their expressed opinions.
 
It should also allow greater freedom to debate important issues.
